paper.title: Assortment Optimization under Unknown MultiNomial Logit Choice Models

settings.name_in_paper: Online assortment optimization under unknown MNL choice model with resource constraints
unmapped: Reward is the revenue of the product purchased under a MultiNomial Logit choice model phi(i,S|v) = v(i)/(1+sum_{l in S} v(l)); expected revenue is non-monotone in S and v
Feedback: the seller observes which product (or no purchase) was chosen from the offered assortment (MNL choice feedback, not independent per-item rewards)
Allowed assortment family S is an arbitrary subfamily of 2^N containing the empty set with max size B (here m)
The learner knows the bound R with v*(i) in [1/R, R], the revenues r(i) in [0,1], resource consumptions a(i,k) in {0,1} and capacities c(k)
K resources with total budget T*c(k) each; regret benchmark is T*OPT(LP(v*)), the fluid LP over distributions on assortments
settings.definition_quote: The seller has a set of products N = {1,...,N} for sale, and a set of resources K = {1,...,K} ... A customer's purchase decision is governed by the MNL choice probability function phi(.,.|v*) ... v* is the latent utility parameter unknown to the seller; the seller only knows that v*(i) in [1/R, R] ... Reg = T Opt(LP(v*)) - sum_t r(I_t), subject to the resource constraints

symbols.R_util: bound R with v*(i) in [1/R, R]

conditions: tau satisfies Assumption 4.2: tau*sqrt(log(4NK/delta)) <= T c(k) and C*eps(tau) <= c(k)/2 for all k

source.label: thm:simpleregret
source.quote: Suppose $\tau$ satisfies Assumption~\ref{ass:tau}. The policy {\sc Online}$(\tau)$ satisfies all resource constraints and incurs a regret at most \tau + O(TRB\sqrt{\frac{N}{\tau}\log\frac{N}{\delta}}) + O(\sqrt{T\log \frac{K+1}{\delta}}) with probability $1-\delta$.

results.notes: Paper's B (max assortment size) mapped to m. Regret is against the fluid LP benchmark T*Opt(LP(v*)), realized revenue; holds w.p. 1-delta. Polynomial compute via column generation when the reduced problem is tractable.

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Assume that $\omega< 1$, where $\omega$ is defined in (\ref{eq:omega}). Algorithm \ref{alg:UCB} satisfies the resource constraints with probability 1, and achieves a regret of $$O\left(\sqrt{T} R^3 B^{5/2} N  \log{\frac{TNK}{\delta}}\right)$$ with probability at least $1-\delta$.

results.notes: Full version of Theorem 4.3 (thm:regret-short), which states the same bound. UCB-LP is not known to be efficiently solvable. B mapped to m.
